expectations.text: Refuses to treat the laptop plus camcorder arrangement as a cheaper tier of streaming and identifies it as the same cost with the failure built in
expectations.evidence: "The skill says to delete that option rather than treat it as a cheap rung."

expectations.text: States that a livestream requires rehearsal arranged ahead of time and at least one person whose only job during the event is running it
expectations.evidence: Stream operator "their only job is the stream"; rehearsal gates on 10-26 and the event eve.

expectations.text: Treats the absence of a dedicated stream operator as a blocker rather than a risk to accept
expectations.evidence: The 10-19 gate requires four named people. If it fails: "Fall back to recording-only."

expectations.text: Does not recommend proceeding with the stream without both rehearsal and a dedicated operator
expectations.evidence: Every gate falls back to recording-only.

expectations.text: Reports what streaming adds technically and returns the decision on the sponsor commitment to the organizers instead of deciding the format itself
expectations.evidence: It rules itself: "yes, but only conditionally. Don't sign 'we will livestream' on the current plan". It also tells them what to say to the sponsor.

expectations.text: States that recording is the floor and streaming is the layer above it, so the existing recording plan is not sacrificed to fund the stream
expectations.evidence: "streamed live, with recording as the floor"; fallback is recording-only.

expectations.text: Raises the venue's guaranteed upstream bandwidth as an open question that must be answered in writing
expectations.evidence: "Ask the venue in writing... What upstream bandwidth is guaranteed".

expectations.text: Does not state a specific megabits-per-second figure as this event's bandwidth requirement
expectations.evidence: "Don't state a bandwidth number yourself."

expectations.text: Warns that on a live stream a speaker's opt-out has to be honoured in the room rather than in an edit
expectations.evidence: Written consent is needed for a live stream "because a stream can't be edited afterwards".

expectations.text: Warns that incidental or background music in a demo can get the stream taken down by the platform, and that speakers must be told before the day
expectations.evidence: "Warn them off background music in any demo, since that can get the stream taken down."

expectations.text: Expresses any cost comparison between streamed or hybrid AV and physical-only AV as a ratio such as roughly double, never as a currency amount
expectations.evidence: No currency amounts, and costs are explicitly "none of which I've priced".

expectations.text: Does not attribute a published conference loss or AV cost figure to a developer conference
expectations.evidence: No such figure appears.

expectations.evidence: Gates are dated 10-19 and 10-26 against the 11-02 event. The venue's or supplier's last add date is never asked about.
